terms_note: Not live-verified: built from the vendor documentation read on 2026-11-02, no call was made. Prices are per raster image from the pricing page (credits are 1/1000 of a dollar: 35 credits is $0.035). Only raster models are offered because this tool needs PNG, and any model id ending in _vector is refused. Native transparent output is not documented for generation (the background tools and a background_color control exist but say nothing about alpha), so transparency is proven from pixels. Recraft has a separate remove-background tool at $0.01 per request that this adapter does not call. Output terms were not read, so nothing is promised here. Check Paradox's and Steam's rules for AI-generated mod assets before publishing. Image links last about 24 hours.

models.notes: POST /v1/images/generations (JSON, response_format b64_json, image_format png). Edits use POST /v1/images/imageToImage (multipart image, strength 0.5 which is an adapter default, 0 is nearly identical and 1 least similar), which re-renders the whole image. No negative_prompt (V2 and V3 only). No mask. Not live-verified.
Fast, low-cost raster model. Docs: no style support, and image-to-image does not accept it, so it cannot edit. Not live-verified.
Same routes as recraftv4_1. The 1K size list is documented for the V4.1 family and V4 alike. Not live-verified.

Always needs a style, here 1 to 10 style anchor references sent as multipart style_references (64 MB in all). Style references add $0.005 per request, which the estimate includes. It cannot edit: image-to-image does not support V4 styles. Not live-verified.
Previous generation. Takes negative_prompt. Its documented size list reaches 2048 px on the long side. Image-to-image is priced the same, $0.04. Not live-verified.
Cheapest, oldest raster model. Takes negative_prompt. Image-to-image lists V3, V4 and V4.1 only, so it cannot edit. Not live-verified.
